name: 86 Chaos 17.0.53
label: 86 Chaos 17.0.53
releaseTitle: Release Gate State Isolation and Schedule Reliability Repair
notes: Language preference changes now take effect in the same browser tab, and the Spanish release-gate probe always restores the shared QA identity to English.
Schedule Builder availability loading no longer depends on a composite-order query; records are sorted client-side after the tenant-scoped read.
On mobile, the multi-row Schedule Builder control deck scrolls away while the day/date header remains sticky below the app header.

Release-gate selectors now tolerate decorated accessible names, historical identity tests no longer pin the current package to an old release, and permission-gate detection no longer matches incidental 'not available' text.
The over-coverage QA fixture now uses two distinct bartenders so it measures real staffing coverage rather than duplicate shifts for one person.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.53
summary: Repairs same-tab language state, Schedule Builder availability loading, mobile sticky day headers, and release-gate selector/fixture false alarms.
description: A surgical testing-branch repair for the 17.0.52 failed+new evidence set. It fixes the real runtime defects and tightens release-gate assertions that were failing on translated or decorated UI without changing working restaurant behavior.
highlights: Same-tab English/Spanish switching updates the document language immediately.
Schedule availability and coverage tools remain index-light and complete.
Mobile schedule day/date context remains visible without a giant sticky control deck.
Failed+new regression coverage is isolated from shared-account language state and selector decoration.
